title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-priya-2026-03-26
content:
Purpose: prep notes for exec staff sync on 2026-03-26 09:00 PT. Keep focused on three decisions: incident postmortem action sign-off, Dedicated capacity pricing adjustment, and go/no-go on Private pilot expansion.

Agenda (30-40m):
- Quick updates (5m): hiring, runway, top-of-funnel metrics
- Ops incident brief (10m): summary, root cause, mitigation, proposal for SLO adjustments
- Product & Pricing (10m): hosted API pricing test results, Dedicated reserve tiers proposal
- Sales & Customer (5m): ACV motion with large deal, support ask for data room
- People / org (5m): recruiting blockers for infra and applied-ml teams

Notes and talking points:
1) Quick updates
- Hiring: still short 3 backend infra ICs; pipeline looks ok but interview throughput low. Evan to propose two interviewers to rotate.
- Cash/runway: finance projection updated last week; runway comfortable through Q2 2027 with current burn if dedicated deal cadence holds. No immediate changes.
- Metrics: hosted API q/q active dev accounts +14%, daily requests +9%, median latency stable, p95 increased 12% for long-tail sequences (>1024 tokens).

2) Ops incident (ENG-4821) - summary
- 2026-03-20 outage: degraded Dedicated throughput for 2.5 hrs after autoscaler regression + kernel selection fallback loop. Impact: 4 enterprise customers saw increased tail latency and throttling.
- Root cause: autoscaler race + model variant mismatch on fallback path. Reproducer in staging: yes.
- Short-term mitigations applied: revert autoscaler change, disable variant fallback for 24h.
- Proposed longer-term fixes:
  - Stabilize autoscaler: add leader election and backoff (ENG owner: Liam)
  - Harden fallback path: require model-compatibility handshake before switch (owner: Maya)
  - Expand e2e chaos tests for fallback scenarios (owner: SRE team)
- Decision needed: approve prioritization and accept 2-story sprint to fix (estimate 1.5 weeks).

3) Product & Pricing
- Hosted API pricing A/B pilot (region: NA) ran 2 weeks. Preliminary: 6% reduction in unit price increased usage by 3% and revenue roughly flat; margin compressed slightly.
- Dedicated reserve tiers proposal: introduce Medium reserve (2x throughput) at 10% discount vs small, Large at 18% discount. Sales asks clearer predictability for customers; engineering impact on scheduling modest.
- Decision needed: sign off on pilot extension for pricing and green-light new reserve tier pricing for beta customers.

4) Sales & Customer success
- Large enterprise deal (ACV ~ $1.8M): legal/data room items require SOC2 scoping doc and KV encryption confirmation. CS to supply compliance package by 3/30.
- Support ask: provide per-route latency slices and token cost breakdown for their eval. Analytics to deliver sample report (owner: Zara).

5) People / Org
- Recruiting: infrastructure IC pipeline weak; propose temporary contractor for 12 weeks to unblock kernel work (costs in FYQ2). Decision: approve contractor up to $45k.
- Org alignment: shrink weekly infra sync from 90 -> 60 min, shift deep technical reviews to biweekly working sessions.

Open questions / risks
- If we slow variant fallback rollout, will downstream apps see quality regressions? Need quick eval on 10 critical customer prompts. (owner: Applied ML)
- Pricing changes: risk of churn in price-sensitive startups; recommend targeted pilot instead of blanket change.

Action items (concrete)
- Evan Chang - rotate interviewers schedule and add 2 interviewers to pipeline by 2026-04-02. Due: 2026-04-02.
- Liam O'Connor - implement leader election and backoff in autoscaler PR and get review started. Target PR by 2026-03-31.
- Maya Torres - spec and begin changes for model-compatibility handshake for fallback path. Draft spec in Confluence by 2026-03-29.
- SRE (owner: Jonah) - add chaos test for fallback scenarios to staging and report results. First run due 2026-04-05.
- Zara Ahmed - produce per-route latency & cost sample report for prospective enterprise by 2026-03-30.
- Applied ML (owner: Priya) - run 10-customer prompt eval for quality impact from disabling fallback; summary due 2026-03-30.
- Finance - provide contractor budget approval for infra contractor up to $45k. Finance owner: Carla. Decision by 2026-03-28.

Notes to self (Priya)
- Walk through the incident timeline with Liam and Maya 1:1 before the sync (30m) - schedule for 2026-03-25 or earliest availability.
- Bring the pricing A/B deck slides and the revenue sensitivity table to share screen. Link: confluence: /pages/pricing-ab-test-2026-03.
- Remind CEO to keep discussion to decisions vs status; call out the three decisions at the top.

Parking lot (if time)
- Redwood Private: pilot expansion ask from 2 customers wanting on-prem packaging; need legal checklist and deployment runbook.
- Longer-term: product suggestion to expose per-request cost estimation in API for customers to control spend.

Quick prep checklist for meeting
- Slides: 6 slides (incident one-pager, pricing summary, sales update, hiring ask, decisions slide) - Evan to confirm visuals.
- Printouts: one-pager incident summary + action table.
- Bring updated runbook link and PR numbers for quick reference.

"If asked" lines (short answers)
- Q: Why did autoscaler revert happen? A: race condition in leader election combined with aggressive backoff change. Revert prevents cascading fallback loop.
- Q: Will pricing change reduce revenue? A: short-term margin compress, long-term aim is volume expansion; pilot to validate.

End.
